hmm.design: complete parent-contract grid because inference is deterministic and inexpensive

tcn.design: three-point calibrated screen spanning compact, intermediate and wide/deep TCNs; all use the learning rate that passed the same-budget synthetic control

default_replay.requirement: reproduce all five default-arm R0 metrics before any sweep candidate is evaluated

triage_gate.primary: RE must have strictly higher boundary F1 at 0.2 cM and non-worse log-loss than F0, RD, POOLED, SHAM and GEOMETRY
guardrails: macro ancestry-dose MAE must be non-worse than every comparator
NAM ancestry-dose MAE must be non-worse than every comparator
false transitions per Morgan must be non-worse than every comparator

positive_control_policy.result: Additive passed from 200 updates; nearby XOR first passed at 1600 updates in the fixed image.
positive_control_policy.failure_rule: A failed same-budget control means BUDGET_INSUFFICIENT, not absence of biological signal and not scientific closure
